name: neurovoice-monorepo
description: NeuroVoice monorepo - vocal biomarker research and screening support platform

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others "npm run dev --prefix web" "cd api && ../venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000" --names="WEB,API" --prefix-colors="cyan,magenta"
scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start --prefix web -p 3000" "cd api && ../venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000" --names="WEB,API"
scripts.install:all: npm i --prefix web && pip install -r api/requirements.txt
